column2: 我是真葡萄樹，我父是栽培的人。
column3: 'I am the true vine, and My Father is the vinedresser.

column2: 凡屬我不結果子的枝子，他就剪去；凡結果子的，他就修理乾淨，使枝子結果子更多。
column3: 'Every branch in Me that does not bear fruit, He takes away; and every [branch] that bears fruit, He prunes it so that it may bear more fruit.

column2: 現在你們因我講給你們的道，已經乾淨了。
column3: 'You are already clean because of the word which I have spoken to you.

column2: 你們要常在我裡面，我也常在你們裡面。枝子若不常在葡萄樹上，自己就不能結果子；你們若不常在我裡面，也是這樣。
column3: 'Abide in Me, and I in you. As the branch cannot bear fruit of itself unless it abides in the vine, so neither [can] you unless you abide in Me.

column2: 我是葡萄樹，你們是枝子。常在我裡面的，我也常在他裡面，這人就多結果子；因為離了我，你們就不能做甚麼。
column3: 'I am the vine, you are the branches; he who abides in Me and I in him, he bears much fruit, for apart from Me you can do nothing.

column2: 人若不常在我裡面，就像枝子丟在外面枯乾，人拾起來，扔在火裡燒了。
column3: 'If anyone does not abide in Me, he is thrown away as a branch and dries up; and they gather them, and cast them into the fire and they are burned.

column2: 你們若常在我裡面，我的話也常在你們裡面，凡你們所願意的，祈求，就給你們成就。
column3: 'If you abide in Me, and My words abide in you, ask whatever you wish, and it will be done for you.

column2: 你們多結果子，我父就因此得榮耀，你們也就是我的門徒了。
column3: 'My Father is glorified by this, that you bear much fruit, and [so] prove to be My disciples.

column2: 我愛你們，正如父愛我一樣；你們要常在我的愛裡。
column3: 'Just as the Father has loved Me, I have also loved you; abide in My love.

column2: 你們若遵守我的命令，就常在我的愛裡，正如我遵守了我父的命令，常在他的愛裡。
column3: 'If you keep My commandments, you will abide in My love; just as I have kept My Father's commandments and abide in His love.

column2: 這些事我已經對你們說了，是要叫我的喜樂存在你們心裡，並叫你們的喜樂可以滿足。
column3: 'These things I have spoken to you so that My joy may be in you, and [that] your joy may be made full.

column2: 你們要彼此相愛，像我愛你們一樣；這就是我的命令。
column3: 'This is My commandment, that you love one another, just as I have loved you.

column2: 人為朋友捨命，人的愛心沒有比這個大的。
column3: 'Greater love has no one than this, that one lay down his life for his friends.

column2: 你們若遵行我所吩咐的，就是我的朋友了。
column3: 'You are My friends if you do what I command you.

column2: 以後我不再稱你們為僕人，因僕人不知道主人所做的事。我乃稱你們為朋友；因我從我父所聽見的，已經都告訴你們了。
column3: 'No longer do I call you slaves, for the slave does not know what his master is doing; but I have called you friends, for all things that I have heard from My Father I have made known to you.

column2: 不是你們揀選了我，是我揀選了你們，並且分派你們去結果子，叫你們的果子常存，使你們奉我的名，無論向父求甚麼，他就賜給你們。
column3: 'You did not choose Me but I chose you, and appointed you that you would go and bear fruit, and [that] your fruit would remain, so that whatever you ask of the Father in My name He may give to you.

column2: 我這樣吩咐你們，是要叫你們彼此相愛。
column3: 'This I command you, that you love one another.

column2: 世人若恨你們，你們知道（或作：該知道），恨你們以先已經恨我了。
column3: 'If the world hates you, you know that it has hated Me before [it hated] you.

column2: 你們若屬世界，世界必愛屬自己的；只因你們不屬世界，乃是我從世界中揀選了你們，所以世界就恨你們。
column3: 'If you were of the world, the world would love its own; but because you are not of the world, but I chose you out of the world, because of this the world hates you.

column2: 你們要記念我從前對你們所說的話：僕人不能大於主人。他們若逼迫了我，也要逼迫你們；若遵守了我的話，也要遵守你們的話。
column3: 'Remember the word that I said to you, 'A slave is not greater than his master.' If they persecuted Me, they will also persecute you; if they kept My word, they will keep yours also.

column2: 但他們因我的名要向你們行這一切的事，因為他們不認識那差我來的。
column3: 'But all these things they will do to you for My name's sake, because they do not know the One who sent Me.

column2: 我若沒有來教訓他們，他們就沒有罪；但如今他們的罪無可推諉了。
column3: 'If I had not come and spoken to them, they would not have sin, but now they have no excuse for their sin.

column2: 恨我的，也恨我的父。
column3: 'He who hates Me hates My Father also.

column2: 我若沒有在他們中間行過別人未曾行的事，他們就沒有罪；但如今連我與我的父，他們也看見也恨惡了。
column3: 'If I had not done among them the works which no one else did, they would not have sin; but now they have both seen and hated Me and My Father as well.

column2: 這要應驗他們律法上所寫的話，說：他們無故的恨我。
column3: 'But [they have done this] to fulfill the word that is written in their Law, 'THEY HATED ME WITHOUT A CAUSE.'

column2: 但我要從父那裡差保惠師來，就是從父出來真理的聖靈；他來了，就要為我作見證。
column3: 'When the Helper comes, whom I will send to you from the Father, [that is] the Spirit of truth who proceeds from the Father, He will testify about Me,

column2: 你們也要作見證，因為你們從起頭就與我同在。
column3: and you [will] testify also, because you have been with Me from the beginning.
